posts.text:
Gas prices are out of control, community-based hospitals are closing in rural America and the Trump Tariffs have made your life more expensive.

Things aren’t going well in this era of far right extremism.

Thank you for your attention to this matter.

The Strait of Hormuz is closed, gas prices are soaring and billions of taxpayer dollars have been wasted.

How is this reckless war of choice working out for the American people?

America will not be lectured about civility by far right extremists in Congress.

Particularly those who provide aid and comfort to hundreds of violent rioters who brutally beat police officers on January 6.

There will be ample time to vigorously debate the issues of the day.

Now is a time to unify.

Violence is never the answer.

We can agree to disagree with each other without ever being disagreeable.

Video

Thankful for the swift law enforcement action to protect everyone from gunfire at the White House Correspondents Dinner.

Praying for the safety of those who may remain in harm’s way.

The violence and chaos in America must end.

Republican extremists are Big Mad that the American people have turned against their failed policies.

Keep the pressure on.

Do you plan on charging rent for space I am occupying in your head?

#HealthcareNotWarfare
Regime change is coming to the United States Congress in November.

Republicans have done nothing to lower the high cost of living.

They have made life more expensive.

And the American people know it.

House Democrats will strongly oppose the Republican budget scheme to give ICE another $70 billion.

We must stop Donald Trump’s violent and dangerous mass deportation machine that targets American citizens.

And we will.

You started this redistricting war.

The people of America will finish it.

Pipe down.

House Democrats have crushed Donald Trump’s national gerrymandering scheme. 

Prop 50 in California ✅ 
Dummymander in Texas ✅
Pushed them back in Ohio ✅
Picked up a seat in Utah ✅
Stopped them in Indiana ✅
Stopped them in Kansas ✅
Stopped them in Nebraska ✅
Stopped them in NH ✅
Big win in Virginia ✅

Maximum warfare, everywhere, all the time.

The so-called indictment against the Southern Poverty Law Center announced by Todd Blanche and Kash Patel is baseless and illegitimate. 

These partisan hacks who continue to weaponize the criminal justice system against perceived opponents will never intimidate us. 

And all of them will be held accountable for their corrupt behavior no matter what it takes. 

newsweek.com/doj-southern-po…

Donald Trump told his MAGA base in Virginia to vote no on today’s referendum.

Why?

"If the Democrats, look - if they get additional House seats, at some point, if they get these additional seats, they're going to be making changes at the federal level."

No lie detected.

Video

Republicans want to cut Medicare and Medicaid.

To pay for their reckless and costly war of choice in the Middle East.

That would be a Hard NO.
